title: A user with the Viewer role can make Grafana allocate an unbounded amount of memory, and crash it, with a single SQL…
description: CVE-2026-107509 is a vulnerability in Grafana where a user with the Viewer role can cause the application to allocate an unbounded amount of memory and crash by submitting a single SQL Expression query that casts a value to a very large BINARY length. This results in a denial of service due to excessive memory consumption.
